source: Independently reasoned unregistered technical closure fixtures; no host observation or authored curriculum count

lesson.prerequisite_note: Technical closure fixture only. Review local port groups and access/trunk VLAN settings before this independent practice.

concepts.title: Several cables, one agreement
concepts.text: The physical cables remain separate. A local group describes which compatible ports may act together; its number belongs to that switch.

concepts.title: Initiating the agreement
concepts.text: Active starts negotiation. Passive can respond. Two passive ends do not start this fresh modeled agreement.

concepts.title: Members must fit locally
concepts.text: A port must match its own group rate and link profile, and both cable ends need compatible line rates and full duplex.

concepts.title: Membership is not VLAN admission
concepts.text: A ready group does not guarantee the requested data VLAN is active and allowed at both ends. Check each required VLAN separately.

concepts.title: Testing a loss without changing work
concepts.text: The supplied loss cases temporarily calculate one cable as down. They do not bring real links down or change your saved configuration.

concepts.title: Keep the working path
concepts.text: The named healthy ports, groups and VLAN databases must retain their initial settings. Apply edits explicitly, then Check current outcomes.

lesson.example_description: Inspect the separate gallery switches, populate the worked configuration, then Apply it. This practice cannot complete the assignment.

example_actions.title: Populate the separate worked configuration
example_actions.explanation: Fill prepares only the gallery draft. Apply publishes that draft to the simulated gallery switches; no host or IOS command runs.

try_change.description: Disable the first participating port on the left gallery switch, Apply, then Check how member and loss requirements change.
